note: Snapshot bar-count fix + SIMILAR CONDITIONS section. Two things in one ship from the round table. The bar count bug: every loop inside buildSnapshot (bar render, signals collection, latest-signal scan) was bounded by n (end of full data) instead of startIdx + barCount. For tail snapshots that looked fine because startIdx was already near n. For right-click neighborhoods anywhere in the middle of data, the snapshot printed from the cursor all the way to the end. Kirk's chair test caught it: 'when I right-click, it captures more than the ten bars to the left and right of the click.' Fix: introduce endIdx = min(n, startIdx + barCount) and use it as the upper bound in all four places (signals loop, header display, bar render loop, latest-signal scan). The SIMILAR CONDITIONS section: Opus's brief — after the existing summary, scan the full candle history for bars where temperature is within 5 of the reference bar, ΔT has the same sign, and IPS is within 1.0. For each match, record what happened at +5, +10, +20 bars. Report counts, average percentage moves, and percent positive returns. Label clearly as historical frequency not prediction. Reference bar is the cursor target on right-click, otherwise the last bar. Six new smoke locks for the bar count fix, seven for SIMILAR CONDITIONS. The snapshot is now a research tool — the last N times this setup occurred, here's what released.
